gaps.sentence: If she ___ the warning signs, the accident would not have happened.
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition takes the past perfect: had noticed.

gaps.sentence: As long as the audio ___ working, the dictation test can go ahead.
gaps.explanation: Conditions about the present take the present simple after as long as.

gaps.sentence: I will be surprised if he ___ on time for once.
gaps.explanation: The if-clause of a real future condition takes the present simple: arrives.

gaps.sentence: I wish I ___ how to play the piano.
gaps.hint: wish plus past for present regret
gaps.explanation: 'Wish' plus past simple expresses regret about a present situation: knew.

gaps.sentence: You'd have got a better exchange rate ___ at the bank instead of the airport.
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition takes 'if + past perfect'.

gaps.sentence: I will tell her the news when I ___ her at the party.
gaps.hint: when clauses take present for future
gaps.explanation: Time clauses with future meaning use the present simple, not 'will': see.

gaps.sentence: Children may use the pool provided that they ___ by an adult.
gaps.hint: provided that plus a passive rule
gaps.explanation: Rules with 'provided that' use the present simple passive: are accompanied.

gaps.sentence: If only I ___ more at university!
gaps.explanation: 'If only + past perfect' — regret about a past failure.
